name: Protocol Feature
summary: Combat Protocol Feature Ranger Your accurate weapons also ignore heavy cover once per round. Vanguard Your rad or poison effects impose disadvantage on the target’s next Strength or Constitution save. Protector Your protection reaction may target two allies within 30 ft. Data-Hunter Your identified target grants +1 to allied attack rolls until your next turn. Infiltrator You may remain hidden after a miss. Ruststalker Your melee hits against bloodied targets deal +1d8 damage.
